currentEtLStatus.advisoryStatus: Maine now loads official SOS certified President rows and town-level President-versus-U.S.-Senate review rows. Advisory indicators are source-review signals only, not findings of fraud or misconduct.

availableEvidence: The official 2024 results page lists U.S. President by County/Town (Excel).
The same page lists U.S. President by Congressional District (Excel), useful for Maine's split electoral-vote context.
No Maine native result or review parser is loaded in etl/state-configs/me.json.
certifiedResults.parserNeeded: Loaded by nativeMaineSosCountyTownXlsx from the official President by County/Town workbook. County totals plus State UOCAVA reconcile to 831,375 candidate votes; blank ballots remain source caveat context and are not candidate votes.
certifiedResults.caveat: State UOCAVA is loaded as a non-geographic certified result row and excluded from town review joins; county geometry can map county rows only.

missing: municipality/town geometry or official reporting-unit crosswalk for subcounty overlays
manual review of the three vote-share-only grain mismatches: Medway/Twps, Day Block Twp, and Wesley
sameGrainComparisonContest.caveat: U.S. Senate is loaded as the same-source comparison contest, but it includes a major independent candidate. Democratic/Republican dropoff metrics are directional source-review inputs. Medway/Twps, Day Block Twp, and Wesley remain vote-share-only because the Senate workbook combines or labels those units at a different grain.

rankedChoiceAndCastVoteRecords.parserNeeded: Separate RCV/CVR package parser for Representative to Congress District 2 source-review context.
rankedChoiceAndCastVoteRecords.caveat: These CD2 ballot-ranking exports do not substitute for statewide President-versus-U.S.-Senate review rows.

stateNativeTurnout.parserNeeded: Active/inactive registered-enrolled text files are collected as denominator leads, but turnout remains EAC fallback until compatible official ballots-cast or voter-participation rows are collected and reconciled.
stateNativeTurnout.caveat: The 11/5/2024 registered/enrolled active and inactive files are denominator leads, not complete turnout replacements by themselves. The submitted current and previous enrollment pages were rechecked July 6, 2026; they continue to support denominator leads, not a ballots-cast turnout replacement.

confirmedContext: The 2024 results page publishes CD2 ranked-choice summary and cast-vote-record Excel exports.
The voter-data page documents Central Voter Registration System data request forms; this is voter-file CVR terminology and should not be confused with cast vote records.
No normalized 2024 audit selection/outcome, recount disposition, incident, correction, or litigation rows are loaded.
auditRecountCvrIncidentCorrectionLitigat.nextAction: Use official SOS publications and records-request channels to scope post-election audit materials, CD2 recount/RCV supporting records, CVR availability/exportability, incident/correction records, and litigation records before normalization.

equipmentContext.caveat: Equipment context is source-linked administration metadata only; it is not vote, turnout, audit, incident, or proof-of-uniform-precinct evidence.

sourceAcquisitionDecision.reason: Maine SOS publishes official 2024 certified result workbooks as Excel files, including President by County/Town and United States Senator, plus CD2 ranked-choice/CVR Excel exports. Parser work and reconciliation remain before native result/review rows are loaded.

remainingRisks: State UOCAVA is non-geographic: it is included in certified totals but not mapped or used in town review joins.
Three President town rows remain vote-share-only because the Senate workbook grain differs: Medway/Twps, Day Block Twp, and Wesley.
U.S. Senate includes a major independent candidate, so Democratic/Republican dropoff fields are directional source-review inputs only.
Turnout remains EAC fallback; collected Maine SOS active/inactive registered-enrolled files are denominator leads only until compatible ballots-cast or voter-participation rows are collected.
Municipality/town geometry or a reporting-unit crosswalk is not loaded.
2012 official historical artifacts are collected but not parsed because they are legacy .xls files.
No normalized 2024 audit, recount, CVR availability, incident, correction, or litigation rows are loaded.
All advisory language must remain source-review context, not evidence of fraud or misconduct.
